title: Assessment Record and the Party-Prevention Nights — Roamhaven Listings Decision Card
content:
# Assessment Record and the Party-Prevention Nights

*Decision card for Roamhaven Listings.*

## Rule

The party-prevention nights of a listing — all of its party-prevention nights added together — are then read against the quality assessments recorded on the listing within the last twelve months:

1. When at least **3** quality assessments were recorded on the listing within the last twelve months and every one of them has outcome **pass**, the party-prevention nights are **halved**, and any half night is rounded up to a whole night.
2. When any quality assessment recorded on the listing within the last twelve months has outcome **warning** or **suspension**, the party-prevention nights are **doubled**.
3. Otherwise the party-prevention nights are counted as they are.

The party-prevention nights as the assessment record leaves them are the nights that sit on top of the standard minimum-stay floor.

## Decision table

| Assessments recorded on the listing in the last twelve months | Party-prevention nights become |
|---|---|
| 3 or more, every one a pass | half, a half night rounded up |
| at least one warning or suspension | double |
| anything else (fewer than 3, or a not-assessed outcome among them, with no warning or suspension) | as they are |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Party-prevention nights added together | Record | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 4 assessments, all pass | 3 halved is 1.5, rounded up to 2 |
| 4 | 3 assessments, all pass | 2 |
| 1 | 3 assessments, all pass | 0.5, rounded up to 1 |
| 3 | one warning among the assessments | 6 |
| 3 | 2 assessments, both pass | 3 — fewer than 3 assessments |
| 2 | 4 assessments: 3 pass and 1 not assessed | 2 — not every one a pass |
| 0 | any record | 0 |
